answer: Resist sybils by making admission itself expensive: each new identity must lock a bond sized to recent network rewards and only recover it after N epochs of attested work with no conflicting signatures. A sudden tide of clones then forces the attacker to immobilize capital for the whole delay, paying most when their campaign hits its zenith. A zephyr of disposable names cannot undercut that carry cost, because slashable attestations and per-identity rate limits waste the stake before the sockpuppets can vote or grade.
